system.description: When you roll to escape (such as slipping your restraints, squeezing through the bars, breaking the grip of a creature holding you, or pulling free from sucking quicksand) and your roll is less than a 9, treat the roll as a 9. (This means you don't get a GM intrusion if you roll a 1.) Action. Effort: Increase the minimum number rolled for this ability by 3. At tier 3: The minimum number rolled for this ability increases to 12.
